d1-test-private-attribute.reason: Ruff SLF001 (private-member-access) is enabled globally in ruff.toml and project-init (including test files) and covers 100% of external private-attribute accesses.

g10-single-call-hop.reason: It matched a function whose body is one call statement by syntax alone, which measured the wrong property: it flagged contracts, registered callbacks, public exports and shared literals, and missed composed-call hops.

g21-vague-name-typescript.reason: TypeScript static rules are owned by @joedeleeuw/antidrift, which enforces this check with ESTree and lexical scope analysis.

g5-compat-identifier-typescript.reason: TypeScript static rules are owned by @joedeleeuw/antidrift, which enforces this check with ESTree and lexical scope analysis.

s5-dated-comment-typescript.reason: TypeScript static rules are owned by @joedeleeuw/antidrift, which enforces this check with ESTree and lexical scope analysis.

w4-nullable-tuple-rust.reason: Independent optional tuple members do not establish mutually exclusive states.

g9-boolean-map-rust.reason: Boolean maps can encode negative caches, partial updates, and independent two-state properties; a set is not equivalent.

w4-parallel-maps-rust.reason: Equal key types do not prove shared membership, lifecycle, or one state owner.

g11-pub-lock-field-rust.reason: Visible lock fields do not prove an invalid public contract or unsafe synchronization.

hash-compare.reason: It matched every comparison involving a hash, so it could not tell a redundant re-verification from a real integrity check.
